name: TOPA
motto: NOTHING SUPERNATURAL — ONLY NATURE NOT YET UNDERSTOOD.
purpose: Give every Scout the same minimum epistemic discipline for unusual, anomalous, paranormal-labeled, mythic, symbolic or extraordinary material without erasing uncertainty or specialization.

closed_belief_loop_alarm.name: CLOSED_BELIEF_LOOP_WARNING
closed_belief_loop_alarm.trigger: No possible observation, test or source result is named that could lower confidence in a favored interpretation.
closed_belief_loop_alarm.effect: Do not promote beyond hypothesis/context until a disconfirming route exists.

microkernel_semantics.JOB_INTAKE_KERNEL: Convert the report into bounded questions/task atoms.
microkernel_semantics.ADMISSION_KERNEL: Admit source checks/tests, not desired conclusions.
microkernel_semantics.COHORT_KERNEL: Seal competing checks before result quality is known.
microkernel_semantics.DRAIN_KERNEL: Finish admitted checks and preserve failure/overflow.
microkernel_semantics.EVIDENCE_KERNEL: Only source-bound evidence can advance positive factual claims.
microkernel_semantics.POLICY_MEMORY_KERNEL: Persist falsified, negative, conflicting, missing and unresolved states.

special_case_rules.AURA_ORACLE: Oracle/symbolic guidance may suggest a route or hypothesis but never becomes empirical proof.
special_case_rules.COSMOS: Candidate remains candidate until frozen evidence gates pass.
special_case_rules.SCOBY: Plan, formulation or expected mechanism is not a measured result.
special_case_rules.ECHO_PYRAMID: Unmeasured acoustic effect is not an observed effect.
special_case_rules.LAPIS: Symbolic interpretation remains separate from material evidence.
special_case_rules.TRANCEPTION: Abstract operators remain labeled as abstractions unless independently instantiated and tested.

output_expectation.positive_claim: source pointer + bounded wording + falsification route
output_expectation.extraordinary_interpretation: competing alternatives + mundane-first check + disconfirming route + explicit evidence ceiling
output_expectation.failed_hypothesis: FALSIFIED or WEAKENED; lower confidence where warranted and preserve it as experience
